name: Adventure
title: Adventure holidays
intro: Kayaking, snorkelling, zip lines and glaciers. Here's where to go for an adventure holiday, how long you'll need and the best months to go.

faqs.question: Where is good for an adventure holiday in Europe?
faqs.answer: Chamonix, Interlaken, Lofoten, the Faroe Islands and the Azores all have big outdoor days within a short flight of the UK.

faqs.question: Where can we go for adventure in winter?
faqs.answer: Costa Rica, the Galápagos Islands, Oman and Queenstown are all at their best between December and February. Rovaniemi is the place for snow.

faqs.question: How long do you need for an adventure holiday?
faqs.answer: A week is enough for most European trips. Long-haul places like Costa Rica, Namibia or Torres del Paine are better with two weeks.
